title: Contributors credited in the dataset

fields.name: handle
fields.description: The name used in translated_by, author, checked_by, reviewed_by, ruled_by and auditor. For people with a GitHub account it is their GitHub username in lowercase; otherwise a lowercase slug chosen at sign-up.

fields.name: credit_name
fields.description: Name as the person wants it in credits. Empty: credit the handle.

fields.name: github
fields.description: GitHub username, as GitHub shows it. Required for review-board members and maintainers, who approve pull requests on GitHub.

fields.name: licence_words
fields.description: Licence the person agreed to for word translations and other data

fields.name: licence_sentences
fields.description: Licence the person agreed to for sentences and prompts

fields.name: consent
fields.description: How the licences were agreed: dco (Signed-off-by on their commits) or the version of the contribution tool's consent text, e.g. tool-2026-11

fields.name: joined
fields.description: Date of the first contribution, YYYY-MM-DD

$comment: _meta/contributors.tsv. Never put email addresses or other contact details here: they stay in the contribution tool's database and are never committed.
